citeturn30search4 [wordlim: 200] Published: 1.6 years ago; Crawled: 3 weeks ago; April 1 - Goldman Sachs GS has lowered its year-end S&P 500 target for the second time this month amid concerns over rising tariffs, slowing growth, and persistent inflation. ... Equity Strategist David Kostin noted that a combination of higher tariffs and weaker economic performance prompted the firm to cut its forecast from 6,200 to 5,900. ... In tandem, Goldman has increased its 12-month recession probability to 35% from 20% and trimmed its 2025 GDP forecast to 1.0% from 1.5% on a Q4 basis.
